proposed_operator_checks.name: availability
proposed_operator_checks.trigger: Repeated non-200 or timeout after accounting for explicitly identified free-service wake-up
proposed_operator_checks.cadence: To be agreed with the existing no-cost monitoring provider; no provider configured
proposed_operator_checks.notification: State change or failure only; no patient URLs or form data

proposed_operator_checks.name: latency
proposed_operator_checks.trigger: Compare measured DNS/TCP/TLS/TTFB/total and Server-Timing app/db; choose thresholds after a representative baseline
proposed_operator_checks.cadence: After releases/incidents and an operator-approved observation window
proposed_operator_checks.notification: Sustained deviation against the approved baseline

proposed_operator_checks.name: backup_age_and_result
proposed_operator_checks.trigger: Missed approved daily backup window, failed authentication/manifest verification or failed resume hook
proposed_operator_checks.cadence: Existing private scheduler after acceptance; schedule disabled
proposed_operator_checks.notification: Existing private alert route required; no automatic external message configured

proposed_operator_checks.name: restore_freshness
proposed_operator_checks.trigger: Latest accepted restore exercise exceeds operator-agreed period or data schema changes
proposed_operator_checks.cadence: Operator-agreed; proposed monthly plus material changes
proposed_operator_checks.notification: Meaningful failure or required operator action

proposed_operator_checks.name: email_receipt
proposed_operator_checks.trigger: Authorized invitation/recovery acceptance fails or reports a provider delivery failure
proposed_operator_checks.cadence: After approved SMTP changes and during the agreed pilot
proposed_operator_checks.notification: No addresses, invitation/reset URLs, tokens or message body in monitoring logs
